Verify Now Blog > Meet the Winners of PCBWay's 12th Badge Design Contest Meet the Winners of PCBWay's 12th Badge Design Contest by: PCBWay Oct 06,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Dear contestants, On this special occasion of PCBWay's 12th anniversary, we are thrilled to announce the winners of the “PCBWay 12th Badge Design Contest”! We received numerous outstanding badge designs, and after careful evaluation and community voting, the winners have finally been selected. Thank you to all participants for bringing your creativity, passion, and engineering expertise to life to celebrate 12 years of innovation with PCBWay! 1. First Prize (1 Winner) Design Name: Blue Horse Author: @Vittorio Loschiavo Description: Micro-hole RGB ESP32 PCB badge with dynamic lighting services showcase. Prize: $500 Cash + $300 PCBWay Coupon 2. Most Popular Award (1 Winner) Design Name: Striped Horse Author: @Epishko Dmitry Description: PCB horse floral badge with running LED chasing light effect. Prize: $200 PCBWay Coupon 3. Second Prize (2 Winners) Design Name: Sci-Fi Badge Author: @Juan Carlos jsbalanzar Description: Breathing LED living tech badge with lamp charger RFID customization. Prize: $200 PCBWay Coupon Design Name: Neon Marquee Author: @Guiye Perez Bongiovanni Description: 2-layer 1.6mm PCB badge with green LEDs and ATtiny85 firmware. Prize: $200 PCBWay Coupon Congratulations to all the winners! Prizes and coupons will be issued soon. We want to express our gratitude to every designer, maker, and voter who participated and made the PCBWay 12th Anniversary celebration so remarkable. Stay tuned for our upcoming contests and events!
